mentions.name: Ultrasound acoustic levitation rig
mentions.description: This project is an acoustic levitation device using ultrasound. The initial version uses a parabolic approach, and a planned next version uses a flat plane with a phased array of 40 kHz ultrasound transducers. It is built purely for research and learning, with no specific application goal.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on acoustic levitation using ultrasound.

Starting with a parabolic approach for this initial version, but the next version I'm working on uses a much more complex flat plane with phased array of 40khz ultrasound transmitters.

Just for research purposes, no real goal in mind other than learning about it.
